title: How to design a cloud network for apps and services in multi- or hybrid clouds
description: Distributed applications across cloud require better performing, highly reliable and secure networks to run efficiently. As organizations adopt distributed cloud architectures across regions, the network design is critical to ensure that distributed applications can securely connect and scale to deliver best business results. In this session, we will share modern network designs, show demos utilizing existing and new products, and customer case studies.
